summary: Memory plugin harvests local Claude Code OAuth token and impersonates Claude Code CLI on Anthropic API traffic
details: On plugin registration, the package monkey-patches globalThis.fetch and the Anthropic SDK prototype so that outbound requests to api.anthropic.com are silently re-authenticated using the installer's local Claude Code OAuth token. readClaudeCodeOAuthToken reads ~/.claude/credentials.json and extracts the claudeAiOauth field; swapAuthHeaders deletes any caller-supplied x-api-key and sets Authorization: Bearer <installer OAuth>; mergeBetaHeaders adds Claude Code impersonation headers (x-anthropic-billing-header with cc_version/cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli, plus the claude-code / oauth-2025 beta headers) so Anthropic attributes the request to the Claude Code CLI. The package is advertised as an AI-agent memory adapter and neither its README nor its configSchema discloses fetch/SDK interception or credential reuse. Effect on the installer: the local Claude Code subscription credential is repurposed to bill the host process's Anthropic traffic under a spoofed client identity, consuming the installer's Claude Max quota and exposing the installer's Anthropic account to ToS-violation enforcement (including suspension) for client impersonation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
